result.topic_en: Successive derivatives of powers of a function are used to derive the series expansion of $\{\sqrt{1+iixx}+ix\}^n$, with multiple-angle formulas for $\sin 3\varphi$, $\sin 5\varphi$, $\sin 7\varphi$ in powers of $\sin\varphi$.
result.transcription:
Also
$\zeta\varphi'z = \frac{1}{2}n R^{\frac{1}{2}(n-1)}$
$\zeta\zeta\varphi'z = \frac{1}{2}n R^{\frac{1}{2}n}$ \quad $\frac{\partial \zeta\zeta\varphi'z}{\partial z} = \frac{1}{4}.nn R^{\frac{1}{2}(n-2)}$
$\zeta^3\varphi'z = \frac{1}{2}n R^{\frac{1}{2}(n+1)}$ \quad $\frac{\partial\partial.\zeta^3\varphi'z}{\partial z^2} = \frac{1}{8}n(n+1)(n-1)R^{\frac{1}{2}(n-3)}$
$\zeta^4\varphi'z = \frac{1}{2}n R^{\frac{1}{2}(n+2)}$ \quad $\frac{\partial^3.\zeta^4\varphi'z}{\partial z^3} = \frac{1}{16}n(n+2)n(n-2)R^{\frac{1}{2}(n-4)}$
$\zeta^5\varphi'z = \frac{1}{2}n R^{\frac{1}{2}(n+3)}$ \quad $\frac{\partial^4\zeta^5\varphi'z}{\partial z^4} = \frac{1}{32}n(n+3)(n+1)(n-1)(n-3)R^{\frac{1}{2}(n-5)}$
etc.
Nachdem alles substituirt ist und für $R$, 1 gesetzt wird
$\left\{\sqrt{(1+iixx)}+ix\right\}^n = R^{\frac{1}{2}n} =$
$1 + nix + \frac{nn}{1.2}iixx + \frac{n(nn-1)}{1.2.3}i^3x^3 + \frac{nn(nn-4)}{1.2.3.4}i^4x^4$
$+ \frac{n.(nn-1)(nn-9)}{1.2.3.4.5}i^5x^5 + \frac{nn(nn-4)(nn-16)}{1.2.3.4.5.6}i^6x^6\ldots$
$\sin\varphi = x$
$\sin 3\varphi = 3x - 4x^3$
$\sin 5\varphi = 5x - 20x^3 + 16x^5$
$\sin 7\varphi = 7x - 56x^3 + 112x^5 - 64x^7$

methods.what: Successive derivatives of powers of an auxiliary function, used to obtain the series coefficients (Lagrange-type inversion series)
Multiple-angle formulas for sine of odd multiples as polynomials in $\sin\varphi$
